ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity (white) and 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel coverage across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white (high-intensity) zones occupy the mid-to-distal regions of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large white region punctuated by a distinct, isolated dark elliptical 'eye' blob near the upper margin. The right lobe contains a large white region with internal vertical black striations. The central peduncle area and trailing edge margins are predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with a series of 5-7 distinct peaks and valleys on each lobe; amplitude of serrations is most pronounced on the inner half of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to a sharp, slightly upward-tapering distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, circular pixel groupings (barnacles) are concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertically-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the white pigmentation zone of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both lobe tips; prominent dark circular pigmentation anomaly or scar located on the upper-mid section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'eye-like' dark spot on the left lobe, framed by white pixels, providing a high-contrast focal point.
